title.zh: 席奥扳 · 钢能接力与崩坠合轴
title.en: Seed / Orphie / Trigger · Steel Charge and Downfall overlap

summary.zh: 本站依据原作者与固定技能整理：奥菲丝喷射交席德，崩坠一式后切回奥菲丝前台耗能补钢能；按真实资源恢复，不是逐帧实测最优轴。
summary.en: Site-authored teaching from original guides and fixed skills: Orphie hands over during her beam, then Seed overlaps Downfall with Orphie’s active energy spending; resource-driven recovery, not a tested optimal frame rotation.

conditions.zh: 依据原作者正文与固定Gachabase重组的条件教学；可从0影无专武执行，不是作者逐帧原轴或最高分承诺。
conditions.en: Conditional teaching synthesized from original articles and fixed Gachabase; executable at M0 without signatures, not the author’s frame-perfect rotation or a score guarantee.

conditions.zh: 扳机→奥菲丝→主攻，循环旋转等价；真实快支提示与实际命中优先于表面步骤顺序。
conditions.en: Trigger → Orphie → carry, cyclic rotations equivalent; actual assist prompts and hits take precedence over a nominal step order.

conditions.zh: 准星聚焦由蓄热充能激光命中获得。某成员发动追击只延长该成员自己的效果；不当作全队永久增益。
conditions.en: Zeroed In comes from Heat Charge laser hits. A member’s Aftershock extends only that member’s own effect, not permanent party-wide coverage.

conditions.zh: 扳机提供击破条件，开启奥菲丝额外能力；其25%无视防御仅作用于拥有准星聚焦的成员造成的追击伤害。
conditions.en: Trigger satisfies Orphie’s Stun requirement; the 25% DEF ignore applies only to Aftershock damage by members who have Zeroed In.

conditions.zh: 奥菲丝为本队正兵。后台自动EX不回钢能；席德崩坠不是追击，不把奥菲丝追击专属防御无视套到崩坠上。
conditions.en: Orphie is this team’s Vanguard. Her automatic off-field EX does not feed Steel; Downfall is not an Aftershock and does not gain Orphie’s Aftershock-only DEF ignore.

label.zh: 开局
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 补绝意、喷射交席德，再观察钢能入口
objective.en: Refill Purge, hand over the beam, then check Steel entry

title.zh: 扳机补绝意，放出反向快支
title.en: Refill Purge and produce the reverse assist

input.zh: 长按普攻狙击，确认射击命中；补够绝意后松开，让终结一击命中。
input.en: Hold Basic to snipe and verify hits; release after refilling Purge and land the finishing shot.

trigger.zh: 当前绝意不足以支撑下一轮；有安全射击窗口。已有足量可跳过补充。
trigger.en: Purge is insufficient for the next cycle and a safe sniping window exists; skip replenishment if already sufficient.

complete.zh: 基础每次狙击命中回25、上限100；终结一击命中且25秒冷却已好才出现上一位快支。
complete.en: Base sniper hits restore 25 toward a 100 cap; a finisher hit creates the previous-slot assist only when its 25-second cooldown is ready.

reason.zh: 射击负责资源，松手终结负责交棒；二者不能用按住时间替代。
reason.en: Shots supply resources; the release finisher supplies the handoff. Holding time alone proves neither.

fallback.zh: 未命中就调整瞄准；没有快支则普通切主攻，跳过下一步快支，不计不存在的支援。
fallback.en: Re-aim after misses; without an assist, switch normally to the carry and skip the next assist step.

signal.zh: 终结一击实际命中，上一位主攻快支提示出现。
signal.en: The finishing shot hits and the previous-slot carry assist actually appears.

title.en: Take the carry’s actual Quick Assist

input.zh: 按当前指向主攻的快支提示入场，完成支援攻击。
input.en: Enter through the current carry Quick Assist prompt and finish the assist attack.

trigger.zh: 站位为扳机→奥菲丝→主攻（循环等价）；扳机给上一位、奥菲丝给下一位。
trigger.en: Use Trigger → Orphie → carry cyclically: Trigger assists the previous slot and Orphie the next.

complete.zh: 实际快支完成再继续；奥菲丝加攻需蓄热充能激光命中，Q本身不等于补准星聚焦。
complete.en: Finish the real assist before continuing; Orphie ATK needs a Heat Charge laser hit, not merely an Ultimate.

reason.zh: 两种方向都回到同一主攻；普通切人不算快支，且不自动填主攻资源。
reason.en: Both directions return to the same carry; ordinary switching is not an assist and does not fill carry resources.

fallback.zh: 无提示时普通切入并按实际资源继续；若激光未命中，不假设已取得准星聚焦。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally and follow actual resources; do not assume Zeroed In after a missed laser.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝退到后台后，队友实际攻击且技能就绪才自动追击；≥60能量时可耗30升级，不是免费常驻激光。
label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

title.en: Spend 100 Bottled Heat and hand over during the beam

input.zh: 普通切奥菲丝；蓄炎≥100时长按特殊技，开始喷射出现快支后交主攻。
input.en: Switch normally to Orphie; at 100+ Bottled Heat hold Special, then hand over when the assist appears as firing begins.

trigger.zh: 实际有100蓄炎；目标能被激光命中。开局初始100不代表以后每轮都有。
trigger.en: Actual Bottled Heat is at least 100 and the beam can hit; the initial 100 does not recur every cycle.

complete.zh: 喷射实际开始并出现快支；激光实际命中才取得准星聚焦，切人后让奥菲丝续喷及自动迸射。
complete.en: Confirm firing and the assist; Zeroed In requires the laser to actually hit. Orphie continues firing and then erupts after the switch.

reason.zh: 把蓄炎喷射的动作与主攻输出重叠；此招消耗蓄炎，不能当作消耗60能量。
reason.en: Overlap the Bottled-Heat beam with carry attacks; this spends Heat, not an assumed 60 energy.

fallback.zh: 蓄炎不足先通过实际追击/可用EX积累；没有快支不要提前切断本步，射空则不计加攻。
fallback.en: Build missing Heat through real follow-ups or an available EX; do not claim an assist before it appears, or ATK after a miss.

signal.zh: 喷射开始，实际快支提示指向下一位主攻。
signal.en: Firing begins and the actual next-slot assist points to the carry.

title.en: Take the carry’s actual Quick Assist

input.zh: 按当前指向主攻的快支提示入场，完成支援攻击。
input.en: Enter through the current carry Quick Assist prompt and finish the assist attack.

trigger.zh: 站位为扳机→奥菲丝→主攻（循环等价）；扳机给上一位、奥菲丝给下一位。

label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝已启动的激光在交出控制后继续；实际命中/结束状态为准。
label.en: Orphie’s already-started laser continues after handing over control; follow its actual hits and end state.

title.zh: 席德飞行耗能并观察钢能
title.en: Use Seed flight while watching Steel Charge

input.zh: 有EX能量时点按后长按，弹幕持续命中；单次实际花60能量才会自动接重戮。
input.en: Press then hold an available EX and land the barrage; spending 60 energy in that flight is required for automatic Slaughter.

trigger.zh: 需要钢能或明攻刷新；目标可命中，能量足够支撑所选持续时间。
trigger.en: Steel Charge or Direct Strike needs refreshing; the target is hittable and energy supports the intended duration.

complete.zh: 看实际钢能是否达到0影120/1影100；没有花满60时不假装已打出自动重戮。
complete.en: Read the actual M0 120 / M1 100 Steel threshold; do not assume automatic Slaughter without spending 60 energy.

reason.zh: 自身耗能与合格命中可回钢能，但重戮、崩坠、Q及离场弹本身命中不回钢能。
reason.en: Own energy spending and eligible hits can build Steel; Slaughter, Downfall, Ultimate and the Away shot do not build it on hit.

fallback.zh: 能量不足就回普通四段接重戮的路线；钢能未到阈值先补普攻命中，勿强行崩坠。
fallback.en: Without energy, use the normal four-stage-to-Slaughter route; build missing Steel through Basic hits instead of forcing Downfall.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝退到后台后，队友实际攻击且技能就绪才自动追击；≥60能量时可耗30升级，不是免费常驻激光。
label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

title.en: Overlap after Downfall First Form starts

input.zh: 重戮或Q后且钢能达标，点按/长按普攻发动崩坠，确认二式完成。
input.en: After Slaughter or Ultimate with enough Steel, press/hold Basic for Downfall and confirm Second Form completes.

trigger.zh: 合法前置已完成，0影≥120钢能；1影≥100。EX早松没有自动重戮时先补合法入口。
trigger.en: The legal preceding action is complete and Steel is M0 120+ or M1 100+; after early EX release, obtain a legal Slaughter entry first.

complete.zh: 确认一式启动与钢能消耗；二式自动续接，不能在启动前抢切。
complete.en: Verify First Form began and Steel was spent; Second Form continues automatically, but switching before startup is not equivalent.

reason.zh: 崩坠消耗钢能而非能量；切控后围杀等只保留至退场或3秒，不能宣称后台全过程满增益。
reason.en: Downfall spends Steel, not energy. After handing over control, Besiege-related buffs last only until exit or three seconds, not throughout every off-field hit.

fallback.zh: 未达阈值回普攻/EX；敌人离开攻击区域先重新贴近。启动失败就不标记后台二式。
fallback.en: Return to Basics/EX below threshold; reposition if the target moves. A failed startup creates no assumed background Second Form.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

prep.zh: 开局奥菲丝100蓄炎、席德60钢能；不假定EX开场满能量。已有充足绝意时跳过前两步。
prep.en: Orphie starts with 100 Heat and Seed with 60 Steel; no full EX-energy start is assumed. Skip the first two steps if Purge is already sufficient.

prep.zh: 最后崩坠仅在重戮已发动且钢能到阈值时执行，否则按恢复路线准备。
prep.en: Use the final Downfall only after Slaughter and sufficient Steel; otherwise take the recovery route.

label.zh: 资源循环
label.en: Resource loop

objective.zh: 崩坠二式与奥菲丝前台耗能重叠
objective.en: Overlap Downfall Second Form with active Orphie energy spending

title.zh: 席德普攻四段准备重戮

input.zh: 完成普通攻击至第四段，保持命中；需要防御时先闪避。
input.en: Complete Basic through stage four with actual hits; dodge first when defense is needed.

trigger.zh: EX不足、钢能未够，或选择普通攻击入口；没有已经就绪的重戮快捷机会。
trigger.en: EX/Steel is insufficient, or a normal entry is preferred; no ready Slaughter shortcut is being used.

complete.zh: 看到第四段完成，检查实际钢能和后续输入。
complete.en: Verify stage four finished, then read Steel Charge and the follow-up input.

reason.zh: 这条路线恢复资源并给重戮合法入口；固定四段不保证必有120钢能。
reason.en: This recovers resources and gives a legal Slaughter entry; four stages do not guarantee 120 Steel.

fallback.zh: 被打断就按当前连段恢复；已有≥阈值的一次快捷机会时可改长按重戮。
fallback.en: Recover from the actual combo after interruption; use hold-Basic Slaughter if its one-time threshold shortcut is available.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝退到后台后，队友实际攻击且技能就绪才自动追击；≥60能量时可耗30升级，不是免费常驻激光。
label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

title.zh: 重戮落下，再决定是否崩坠

input.zh: 第四段/闪反/快支/支援突击后点按或长按普攻；有一次阈值快捷机会时可直接长按。
input.en: After Basic 4, Counter, Quick Assist or Follow-Up, press/hold Basic; a ready threshold shortcut allows a direct hold.

trigger.zh: 有上述合法入口；若要接崩坠，实际钢能必须满足0影120、1影100。
trigger.en: A listed legal entry exists; following with Downfall requires actual M0 120 / M1 100 Steel.

complete.zh: 确认重戮已发动；钢能不足就止于本次重戮，不连续空按崩坠。
complete.en: Confirm Slaughter activated; if Steel is insufficient, finish here rather than forcing Downfall.

reason.zh: 重戮本身不产钢能，不能靠它补足接崩坠的差额。
reason.en: Slaughter does not generate Steel on hit and cannot fill the missing Downfall cost.

fallback.zh: 快捷机会已用且没有后续入口就先普攻四段；重戮后资源不足回普攻或EX。
fallback.en: If the shortcut is spent and no entry exists, use four Basics; after an underfunded Slaughter return to Basics or EX.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

title.en: Overlap after Downfall First Form starts

input.zh: 重戮或Q后且钢能达标，点按/长按普攻发动崩坠；确认一式扫射开始再切奥菲丝。
input.en: After Slaughter or Ultimate with enough Steel, press/hold Basic for Downfall; confirm First Form sweeping shots before switching to Orphie.

trigger.zh: 合法前置已完成，0影≥120钢能；1影≥100。EX早松没有自动重戮时先补合法入口。

label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

signal.zh: 确认崩坠一式扫射已开始，再普通切奥菲丝；二式由原动作自动续上。
signal.en: Confirm First Form sweeping shots started, then switch normally to Orphie; the original action automatically continues into Second Form.

title.zh: 奥菲丝前台EX，回补席德钢能
title.en: Spend Orphie energy while active to feed Seed

input.zh: 崩坠一式开始后普通切奥菲丝；有能量时点按EX，随后可接火刀。
input.en: After Downfall First Form begins, switch normally to Orphie; tap an available EX, then optionally connect the fire blade.

trigger.zh: 奥菲丝此时确实为当前操作角色，且EX能量足够。
trigger.en: Orphie is actually the currently controlled character and has enough EX energy.

complete.zh: EX实际消耗能量；每消耗1点为席德回0.5钢能，发动另回20蓄炎并刷新强袭。
complete.en: Verify actual EX energy spending: each point restores 0.5 Seed Steel; use also restores 20 Heat and refreshes Onslaught.

reason.zh: 本队唯一其他强攻是奥菲丝，作为正兵必须前台耗能才回钢能；后台自动EX不计这份回复。
reason.en: Orphie is the sole other Attack agent and thus Vanguard; only her active energy spending feeds Steel, not automatic off-field EX.

fallback.zh: 能量不够别把普通特殊技当EX；保留蓄炎路线，或回席德普攻补资源。
fallback.en: Without energy do not label a normal Special as EX; use the Heat route or return to Seed Basics.

label.zh: 仅已启动崩坠的二式继续；非受控期间命中不按席德前台返正兵能量计算。
label.en: Only an already-started Downfall continues into Second Form; its hits while inactive do not count as Seed active-field energy refunds to Vanguard.

title.en: Spend 100 Bottled Heat and hand over during the beam

input.zh: 普通切奥菲丝；蓄炎≥100时长按特殊技，开始喷射出现快支后交主攻。
input.en: Switch normally to Orphie; at 100+ Bottled Heat hold Special, then hand over when the assist appears as firing begins.

trigger.zh: 实际有100蓄炎；目标能被激光命中。开局初始100不代表以后每轮都有。
trigger.en: Actual Bottled Heat is at least 100 and the beam can hit; the initial 100 does not recur every cycle.

complete.zh: 喷射实际开始并出现快支；激光实际命中才取得准星聚焦，切人后让奥菲丝续喷及自动迸射。
complete.en: Confirm firing and the assist; Zeroed In requires the laser to actually hit. Orphie continues firing and then erupts after the switch.

reason.zh: 把蓄炎喷射的动作与主攻输出重叠；此招消耗蓄炎，不能当作消耗60能量。
reason.en: Overlap the Bottled-Heat beam with carry attacks; this spends Heat, not an assumed 60 energy.

fallback.zh: 蓄炎不足先通过实际追击/可用EX积累；没有快支不要提前切断本步，射空则不计加攻。
fallback.en: Build missing Heat through real follow-ups or an available EX; do not claim an assist before it appears, or ATK after a miss.

signal.zh: 喷射开始，实际快支提示指向下一位主攻。
signal.en: Firing begins and the actual next-slot assist points to the carry.

title.en: Take the carry’s actual Quick Assist

input.zh: 按当前指向主攻的快支提示入场，完成支援攻击。
input.en: Enter through the current carry Quick Assist prompt and finish the assist attack.

trigger.zh: 站位为扳机→奥菲丝→主攻（循环等价）；扳机给上一位、奥菲丝给下一位。
trigger.en: Use Trigger → Orphie → carry cyclically: Trigger assists the previous slot and Orphie the next.

complete.zh: 实际快支完成再继续；奥菲丝加攻需蓄热充能激光命中，Q本身不等于补准星聚焦。
complete.en: Finish the real assist before continuing; Orphie ATK needs a Heat Charge laser hit, not merely an Ultimate.

reason.zh: 两种方向都回到同一主攻；普通切人不算快支，且不自动填主攻资源。
reason.en: Both directions return to the same carry; ordinary switching is not an assist and does not fill carry resources.

fallback.zh: 无提示时普通切入并按实际资源继续；若激光未命中，不假设已取得准星聚焦。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally and follow actual resources; do not assume Zeroed In after a missed laser.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝已启动的激光在交出控制后继续；实际命中/结束状态为准。
label.en: Orphie’s already-started laser continues after handing over control; follow its actual hits and end state.

prep.zh: 已有重戮快捷机会可省普通四段；扳机绝意不足时先补狙击，不要求每轮都从满资源开始。
prep.en: Skip Basic 4 when a Slaughter shortcut is ready; refill Trigger first if Purge is low. Full resources are not assumed each loop.

prep.zh: 奥菲丝不到100蓄炎时先积累并继续席德准备，不为等长按喷射空站；准星聚焦缺失如实处理。
prep.en: Below 100 Heat, accumulate it while continuing Seed setup; do not stand idle waiting for the hold beam or assume absent Zeroed In.

label.zh: 输出窗口
label.en: Damage window

objective.zh: 协战接席德Q/崩坠，奥菲丝Q可续合轴
objective.en: Use coordinated support for Seed Ultimate/Downfall and optional Orphie Ultimate overlap

title.en: Land Trigger EX to start coordinated support

input.zh: 普通切扳机；EX能量够时点按并命中，再按上一位主攻的快支提示。
input.en: Switch normally to Trigger; use an available EX, land it, then follow the previous-slot carry prompt.

trigger.zh: 需要补协战，扳机有EX能量；不是单看绝意已满。
trigger.en: Coordinated support needs refreshing and Trigger has EX energy; a full Purge gauge alone is insufficient.

complete.zh: 确认实际命中及协战：本次8秒/4次普通协奏；再次叠加的总上限20秒/10次。
complete.en: Confirm the hit and coordinated support: this EX gives eight seconds/four ordinary follow-ups, stacking only to 20 seconds/ten triggers.

reason.zh: 普通协奏可免绝意与冷却；冥狱依然耗5绝意且有各招式类别的次数限制。
reason.en: Ordinary follow-ups waive Purge and cooldown; Tartarean still costs five Purge and retains its per-category limits.

fallback.zh: EX未好则跳过，用已有绝意正常追击；绝意也低就回狙击补充。不要假装产生快支。
fallback.en: Skip unavailable EX and use existing Purge for normal support; refill by sniping if low. Do not invent an assist prompt.

signal.zh: EX命中后，上一位主攻的快支提示亮起。
signal.en: EX hits and the previous-slot carry Quick Assist prompt appears.

title.en: Take the carry’s actual Quick Assist

input.zh: 按当前指向主攻的快支提示入场，完成支援攻击。
input.en: Enter through the current carry Quick Assist prompt and finish the assist attack.

trigger.zh: 站位为扳机→奥菲丝→主攻（循环等价）；扳机给上一位、奥菲丝给下一位。
trigger.en: Use Trigger → Orphie → carry cyclically: Trigger assists the previous slot and Orphie the next.

complete.zh: 实际快支完成再继续；奥菲丝加攻需蓄热充能激光命中，Q本身不等于补准星聚焦。
complete.en: Finish the real assist before continuing; Orphie ATK needs a Heat Charge laser hit, not merely an Ultimate.

reason.zh: 两种方向都回到同一主攻；普通切人不算快支，且不自动填主攻资源。
reason.en: Both directions return to the same carry; ordinary switching is not an assist and does not fill carry resources.

fallback.zh: 无提示时普通切入并按实际资源继续；若激光未命中，不假设已取得准星聚焦。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally and follow actual resources; do not assume Zeroed In after a missed laser.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝退到后台后，队友实际攻击且技能就绪才自动追击；≥60能量时可耗30升级，不是免费常驻激光。
label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

title.en: Optional: Seed Ultimate restores Steel Charge

input.zh: 席德自己的Q就绪且窗口允许时发动；然后检查钢能，再决定崩坠。
input.en: Use Seed’s own ready Ultimate if the window permits; read Steel before deciding on Downfall.

trigger.zh: 自身喧响已就绪；不能只因上一位用了Q就认为席德也可用。
trigger.en: Her own Decibels are ready; another agent using an Ultimate does not make Seed’s ready.

complete.zh: 发动获得60钢能，1影再额外20；按150上限读实际余量。
complete.en: Use grants 60 Steel, plus 20 at M1; read actual resources under the 150 cap.

reason.zh: Q给合法崩坠入口，但从零开始0影只回60，仍不能凭Q必接崩坠。
reason.en: Ultimate provides a legal Downfall entry, but M0 gains only 60 from empty and cannot automatically follow it with Downfall.

fallback.zh: Q不可用或钢能未达标则走普攻/EX、重戮路线；不要借用其他人的终结资源。
fallback.en: If unavailable or Steel remains low, use Basics/EX then Slaughter; do not borrow another agent’s Ultimate resource.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝退到后台后，队友实际攻击且技能就绪才自动追击；≥60能量时可耗30升级，不是免费常驻激光。
label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

title.en: Overlap after Downfall First Form starts

input.zh: 重戮或Q后且钢能达标，点按/长按普攻发动崩坠；确认一式扫射开始再切奥菲丝。
input.en: After Slaughter or Ultimate with enough Steel, press/hold Basic for Downfall; confirm First Form sweeping shots before switching to Orphie.

trigger.zh: 合法前置已完成，0影≥120钢能；1影≥100。EX早松没有自动重戮时先补合法入口。
trigger.en: The legal preceding action is complete and Steel is M0 120+ or M1 100+; after early EX release, obtain a legal Slaughter entry first.

complete.zh: 确认一式启动与钢能消耗；二式自动续接，不能在启动前抢切。
complete.en: Verify First Form began and Steel was spent; Second Form continues automatically, but switching before startup is not equivalent.

reason.zh: 崩坠消耗钢能而非能量；切控后围杀等只保留至退场或3秒，不能宣称后台全过程满增益。
reason.en: Downfall spends Steel, not energy. After handing over control, Besiege-related buffs last only until exit or three seconds, not throughout every off-field hit.

fallback.zh: 未达阈值回普攻/EX；敌人离开攻击区域先重新贴近。启动失败就不标记后台二式。
fallback.en: Return to Basics/EX below threshold; reposition if the target moves. A failed startup creates no assumed background Second Form.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝退到后台后，队友实际攻击且技能就绪才自动追击；≥60能量时可耗30升级，不是免费常驻激光。
label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

signal.zh: 确认崩坠一式扫射已开始，再普通切奥菲丝；二式由原动作自动续上。
signal.en: Confirm First Form sweeping shots started, then switch normally to Orphie; the original action automatically continues into Second Form.

title.zh: 可选：奥菲丝Q接主攻快支
title.en: Optional: Orphie Ultimate into carry assist

input.zh: 奥菲丝自己的Q就绪时发动；跃向空中出现快支就让主攻接手。
input.en: Use Orphie’s own ready Ultimate; hand to the carry when the assist appears during her leap.

trigger.zh: 自身喧响已就绪且输出窗口仍在；不借用其他人的Q资源。
trigger.en: Her own Decibels are ready and a damage window remains; another agent’s Ultimate resource is not shared.

complete.zh: Q发动回20蓄炎；实际响应快支后延长本次激光，不因此自动刷新准星聚焦。
complete.en: Ultimate use restores 20 Heat; actually taking the assist extends this laser, without automatically refreshing Zeroed In.

reason.zh: 通过有明文依据的Q续喷减少主攻空档。
reason.en: Use the documented assist-extended Ultimate beam to reduce carry downtime.

fallback.zh: Q未好可跳过；若100蓄炎且需要加攻，改用蓄热充能并响应其真实提示。无两者就普通交主攻。
fallback.en: Skip if unavailable. With 100 Heat and missing ATK, use Heat Charge and its actual prompt; with neither, switch normally to the carry.

signal.zh: 奥菲丝跃起，实际快支指向下一位主攻。
signal.en: Orphie leaps and the actual next-slot assist points to the carry.

title.en: Take the carry’s actual Quick Assist

input.zh: 按当前指向主攻的快支提示入场，完成支援攻击。
input.en: Enter through the current carry Quick Assist prompt and finish the assist attack.

trigger.zh: 站位为扳机→奥菲丝→主攻（循环等价）；扳机给上一位、奥菲丝给下一位。
trigger.en: Use Trigger → Orphie → carry cyclically: Trigger assists the previous slot and Orphie the next.

complete.zh: 实际快支完成再继续；奥菲丝加攻需蓄热充能激光命中，Q本身不等于补准星聚焦。
complete.en: Finish the real assist before continuing; Orphie ATK needs a Heat Charge laser hit, not merely an Ultimate.

reason.zh: 两种方向都回到同一主攻；普通切人不算快支，且不自动填主攻资源。
reason.en: Both directions return to the same carry; ordinary switching is not an assist and does not fill carry resources.

fallback.zh: 无提示时普通切入并按实际资源继续；若激光未命中，不假设已取得准星聚焦。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally and follow actual resources; do not assume Zeroed In after a missed laser.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝已启动的激光在交出控制后继续；实际命中/结束状态为准。
label.en: Orphie’s already-started laser continues after handing over control; follow its actual hits and end state.

prep.zh: 进入前检查准星聚焦；缺失时先用100蓄炎激光补。敌人真实失衡、各自Q与剩余窗口决定执行多少步。
prep.en: Check Zeroed In before entering; restore it with the 100-Heat beam if missing. Real Stun, each agent’s own Ultimate and the remaining window determine how far to proceed.

prep.zh: 若已有协战可跳前两步；Q或钢能不足用循环恢复，不把整套强行塞进每次失衡。
prep.en: Skip the first two steps with sufficient existing support; recover through the loop if Ultimate/Steel is missing instead of forcing the full sequence into every Stun.

text.zh: 奥菲丝1影给拥有准星聚焦的角色增伤；专属火抗无视仅对应列出的奥菲丝招式，不变成全队减火抗。
text.en: Orphie M1 boosts damage of agents with Zeroed In; its Fire RES ignore belongs only to the listed Orphie skills, not a team-wide Fire RES reduction.

text.zh: 奥菲丝2影追击回自身喧响有4秒冷却；Q后的加攻属于她自己，不自动给主攻。
text.en: Orphie M2’s own Decibel gain from Aftershocks has a four-second cooldown; her post-Ultimate ATK belongs to herself, not automatically to the carry.

text.zh: 奥菲丝4影把准星聚焦初始持续改为16秒；仍须蓄热充能激光命中，续时仍按各成员自己的追击。
text.en: Orphie M4 changes initial Zeroed In duration to 16 seconds; Heat Charge must still hit and extensions still follow each member’s own Aftershocks.

text.zh: 扳机1影提高绝意上限与获得效率、缩短普通协奏冷却；协战次数与冥狱开销仍按实际技能。
text.en: Trigger M1 raises Purge capacity/gain and reduces ordinary follow-up cooldown; coordinated counts and Tartarean costs retain their actual skill rules.

text.zh: 扳机2影由发动追击+1猎眸、发动狙击终结一击+2，最多4层；普通狙击四枪不等于直接叠满。
text.en: Trigger M2 gains one Gaze from an Aftershock and two from the sniper finisher, up to four; four ordinary sniper shots do not directly max it.

text.zh: 嚣枪喧焰需要她自己的火属性追击伤害，3秒最多叠1层、最多2层；不会给主攻提供该音擎的防御无视。
text.en: Bellicose Blaze needs her own Fire Aftershock damage, at most one stack per three seconds and two stacks total; it does not grant the carry its DEF ignore.

text.zh: 索魂影眸由电属性追击实际命中挂减防；魂锁另要求扳机不是当前操作角色，同一招式最多1层。
text.en: Spectral Gaze applies DEF reduction on actual Electric Aftershock hits; Spirit Lock additionally requires Trigger to be inactive, at most one stack per skill use.

text.zh: 席德1影崩坠门槛/总消耗改为100钢能，重戮快捷机会同改100；开场额外40、Q额外20。仍要合法前置并看实际资源。
text.en: Seed M1 changes Downfall threshold/total cost and the Slaughter shortcut to 100 Steel, adds 40 at entry and 20 to Ultimate. Legal preceding actions and actual resources still apply.

text.zh: 席德2影飞行可在60能量后继续至最多120，直到松手；长按更久并非0影能力，也不要求每次花满120。围杀防御无视仍看实际生效时段。
text.en: Seed M2 can extend flight beyond 60 to at most 120 energy until release; this is not an M0 ability or a requirement to spend 120 every time. Besiege DEF ignore still requires its active buff window.

text.zh: 席德6影重戮额外激光有3秒触发冷却；不把它视为奥菲丝定义的追击，下一次崩坠仍看实际钢能。
text.en: Seed M6 adds Slaughter lasers with a three-second trigger cooldown; they are not assumed to be Orphie-defined Aftershocks. Check actual Steel for the next Downfall.

text.zh: 机巧心种用普攻/EX实际造成伤害积累增益；2层后才有普攻/Q防御无视。同一招式多段不直接算两层。
text.en: Cordis Germina stacks from actual Basic/EX damage; Basic/Ultimate DEF ignore requires two stacks. Multiple hits of one skill do not automatically grant two.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.扳机补绝意，放出反向快支: 长按普攻狙击，补够绝意后松开
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.席德按提示快支接手: 看到席德快支提示再入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.100蓄炎喷射，交主攻合轴: 100蓄炎时长按特殊技，出现快支再交棒
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.席德飞行耗能并观察钢能: 点按强化特殊技后按住，让弹幕持续命中
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.崩坠一式启动后合轴: 钢能足时按普攻，完成崩坠第二段
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.重戮落下，再决定是否崩坠: 用普攻接重戮，核对钢能
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.奥菲丝前台EX，回补席德钢能: 奥菲丝点强化特殊技，补席德钢能
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.扳机EX命中，开启协战: 扳机点强化特殊技命中，再看主攻快支
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.可选：席德Q补钢能: 可选：席德的终结技就绪时补钢能
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.可选：奥菲丝Q接主攻快支: 可选：奥菲丝开终结技，跃起后交快支

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切奥菲丝；蓄炎≥100时长按特殊技，开始喷射出现快支后交主攻。: 奥菲丝普通入场且蓄炎至少100时，长按特殊技开始喷射。看到主攻的快速支援提示再交棒。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.有EX能量时点按后长按，弹幕持续命中；单次实际花60能量才会自动接重戮。: 能量够时点按强化特殊技，再持续按住让弹幕命中；这次实际消耗60点能量才自动接重戮。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.重戮或Q后且钢能达标，点按/长按普攻发动崩坠，确认二式完成。: 重戮或终结技后，钢能达标时点按或长按普攻，等崩坠第二段完成。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.第四段/闪反/快支/支援突击后点按或长按普攻；有一次阈值快捷机会时可直接长按。: 普攻第四段、闪避反击、快支或支援突击后，点按或长按普攻；若确有一次快捷发动机会，也可直接长按普攻。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.崩坠一式开始后普通切奥菲丝；有能量时点按EX，随后可接火刀。: 崩坠第一段开始后普通切奥菲丝；能量足够时点按强化特殊技，随后可接火属性攻击。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切扳机；EX能量够时点按并命中，再按上一位主攻的快支提示。: 扳机普通入场后，能量够时点按强化特殊技并命中；看到指向主攻的快速支援提示再交棒。
